Resonance zeroes exactly sin h=0 with positive denominator; decay from hyperbolic asymptotics. Nine direct independent matrix exponential/inversion checks tested signs and formula; all-t property is analytic.

final_claim: For every one/two-state continuous-time Markov generator and t>0, F_t^-1 for F_t=phi1(tQ)=int_0^1 exp(stQ)ds is a nonsingular M-matrix. For the directed three-cycle Q=C-I3, F_t^-1=b0 I+b1 C+b2 C² with b0>0,b1<0,b2>0 for all t>0, and b2=1/3-2h sin(h)/[3(cosh(sqrt3 h)-cos h)] with h=sqrt3 t/2. Hence the deviation b2-1/3 vanishes exactly at t=2kπ/sqrt3, k>=1, alternating sign, decaying O(t exp(-3t/2)).
limitations: Exact three-cycle has equal directed rates; t>0 only. No arbitrary n-state/global oscillation conclusion or claims about numerical inversion errors.
